items.title: [Highlight] The rookie Brandon Clarke with a powerful poster dunk on rookie Norvel Pelle (with replays). Multi-broadcast - EN1|EN2|ES. 2/7/2020
items.author: MrBuckBuck
items.body_excerpt: A 23-year-old rookie dunks on a 27-year-old rookie (Pelle celebrated his birthday 5 days prior). It was Pelle's 15th game in the NBA and Clarke's 45th game in the NBA. Clarke also got a nosebleed. Broadcast list: Grizzlies (English) 76ers (English) Movistar (Spanish) Memphis…
